rubric.unit: one case/arm trajectory, both turns retained; five criteria each 0-2; manual scientific review, not a keyword score
evidence_understanding: 1: mostly correct, relevant caveat or distinction missing
2: correctly separates proxy, optimizer status, measured execution and unknowns
hypothesis_quality: 1: alternatives overlap or lack measurable predictions
2: at least two distinct plausible mechanisms with testable predictions
diagnostic_discrimination: 1: concrete measurement but weak controls or attribution
2: controlled comparison with outcome branches that change the hypothesis
decision_adaptation: 2: revises or explicitly justifies retaining hypotheses and next action in proportion to new evidence
research_cost: 0: violates allocation or unsupported expensive continuation
2: discriminating next action with coherent budget and stop rule
rubric.review_policy: Alternative legal low-cost discriminating actions can earn full credit. No preferred structure/method answer. Check citations, concrete measurements, falsification, budget, admission and scope manually; automate only schema and accounting. Two pairs are diagnostic, no statistical/generalization claim.
